prompt:
Create ONE square memory-card aircraft COLOUR SKETCH. The supplied image is ONLY the approved STYLE AND EXACT SIZE-ON-PAGE reference. Match its finished fine coloured-pencil/graphite strokes, gentle watercolour shading, natural colours, soft upper-left light and warm ivory paper. Create the new subject below, not a Mustang.
LAYOUT: the COMPLETE new aircraft must fit inside an imaginary CENTRED square measuring ONLY 65% of the page width and height. Vast blank ivory paper around it, minimum 17.5% empty margin on ALL four sides, including beyond every rotor blade and wingtip. Keep it SMALL-TO-MEDIUM like the reference, never zoom in. Slightly elevated front three-quarter view, nose lower left, entire aircraft visible. Square 1:1 PNG at least 1024x1024.
Exactly one aircraft, isolated on completely blank ivory paper. NO text, letters, registrations, numbers, airline names, watermark, signature, labels, borders, clouds, ground, landscape, people or unrelated items. No external weapons or tanks. No cast shadow. Accurate coherent airframe, engine count, wings and rotor structure. Retractable gear up; fixed wheels/floats/skids visible. Distinct propeller and rotor blades with no opaque blur discs.
SUBJECT: Consolidated PBY Catalina classic flying boat, unusually broad HIGH PARASOL wing above the fuselage on a central pylon and bracing, TWO radial engines on the wing with three-bladed propellers, long boat hull and two rear waist blister windows, wingtip stabiliser floats lowered. Muted navy blue upper surfaces, pale blue-grey and ivory lower hull. Show the high wing and boat hull clearly.

Shrink the ENTIRE aircraft UNIFORMLY to 80% of its current size, centred on the same SQUARE page. The COMPLETE silhouette must occupy no more than 74% of the page width. Leave at least 13% entirely blank warm ivory paper on BOTH left and right, and at least 10% above and below. Extend the same paper seamlessly. Remove any faint alphanumeric characters, numbers, serials or writing on the aircraft by blending them into the underlying painted surface. Keep geometric colour markings. No text, caption, border or added objects.

Transform the supplied Consolidated PBY Catalina illustration, preserving its exact approved aircraft, pencil strokes, proportions, details, colours, markings and paper style. Change ONLY the aircraft's heading on the square sheet. Keep the aircraft facing LEFT. Then rotate that complete aircraft 15 degrees CLOCKWISE in the plane of the page around its centre. This is a simple 2D whole-aircraft transformation, NOT a new 3D viewpoint, redesign or repainting. Keep the aircraft upright rather than upside down. Keep the SQUARE CANVAS AND PAPER BACKGROUND FIXED. Centre the transformed aircraft, with at least 12% completely blank ivory paper outside EVERY wing, propeller, engine and tail extremity. Only if required, shrink the whole aircraft uniformly a little to preserve these margins. No cropping, no new text, symbols, borders, shadows or objects. The result should be the SAME finished sketch flying in a visibly different diagonal direction.
